lines.japanese: 馴らし運転がてら、軽く遠回りしつつ帰宅した。
lines.english: I took a slight detour on the way home, giving the new machinery a little more time to break in.

lines.japanese: アレキサンダーに寄って閉店までバイトして行こうかとも考えたが、今日のところはやめておいた。
lines.english: I considered stopping at Alexander and working until closing, but decided against it for today.

lines.japanese: 試験運用はまだ初日。アレもコレもと欲張ることはない。今日は学校での出来事を振りかえって、明日からに生かそう。
lines.english: It was only the first day of the trial run. No need to grow greedy and attempt everything at once. Today, I would review what happened at school and put the lessons to use tomorrow.

lines.japanese: なにより気疲れした感は否めない。気力の回復を図ろう。
lines.english: More than anything, I was mentally drained. It was time to recharge.

lines.japanese: 「ただいまー」
lines.english: “I'm home!”

lines.japanese: まずは自分の部屋へ戻って寝転がるのだ。
lines.english: First, I would return to my room and lie down.

lines.japanese: よし……俺はこの家が自分の帰る場所だと認識できている。一日のゴールまで、あと少しだ。
lines.english: Good... I recognized this house as the place I came home to. I was almost at the finish line for the day.

lines.japanese: 「奥が鷲介の部屋で……手前がタカシ……俺の帰るべき部屋は……ええと……」
lines.english: “Shusuke's room is farther back... Takashi's is nearer... The room I ought to return to is... er...”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ここは小鳩の部屋か」
lines.english: “Oh. This is Kobato's room.”

lines.japanese: なあんだ、俺の部屋じゃないのか、ははは。
lines.english: Oh, so it wasn't mine. Ha ha ha.

lines.japanese: いやいや、笑いごとじゃないぞ。部屋を間違えるだなんて、これは俺の認識力に重要な問題が生じているんじゃあるまいか。
lines.english: No, no. This was no laughing matter. Mistaking the room suggested some serious fault had arisen in my powers of recognition.

lines.japanese: 「え、えっ……な、なに……？」
lines.english: “Wh-what...? What are you doing...?”

lines.japanese: 「ううむ、大変だ小鳩。もしかしたら俺は、まだ安定してないのかもしれない」
lines.english: “Hmm. This is grave, Kobato. I may not have fully stabilized yet.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、どうしよう……もしかしたら、俺の統合はいずれ内から崩れて、ふたたび不安定な存在に逆戻りするのかもしれない」
lines.english: “Oh, what shall I do...? My integration may collapse from within, reducing me once more to an unstable existence.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええ？　あ、ああああの、ええと……」
lines.english: “What? What? Um, uh...”

lines.japanese: 「ああそうか、ごめんね、驚かせてしまったね。落ちついて、そして悲しまないで。大丈夫、お兄ちゃんはお兄ちゃんパワーでがんばってみせるよ。さあ、顔をあげるんだ、空の色は君次第だから」
lines.english: “Oh, I see. I'm sorry—I frightened you. Calm down, and don't be sad. It'll be all right. Big Brother Power will see me through. Now lift your head. The color of the sky is yours to choose.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はやく、出てって……」
lines.english: “G-get out...”

lines.japanese: 「出てって！？」
lines.english: “Get out!?”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、ひどいや小鳩さん！　なんて酷いことを言うんです、お兄ちゃんそんな子に育てた覚えは──」
lines.english: “M-Miss Kobato! What a terrible thing to say! Your big brother didn’t raise you to be such a—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、そりゃあるわけないか」
lines.english: “—oh. No, of course I didn't.”

lines.japanese: 部屋を一歩踏みいったところで状況判断が整った。
lines.english: One step into the room, my grasp of the situation finally caught up.
“Gah!”

lines.japanese: 「う、ふえぇっ……」
lines.english: “W-wah...”

lines.japanese: そして、いま自分が年頃の妹に大変な恥辱をもたらしている真っ最中だと、遅ればせながら認識した。
lines.english: Only then did I realize that, at that very moment, I was subjecting my adolescent sister to a profound embarrassment.

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ、ふええ……」
lines.english: “Hweh... Hweeeh...”

lines.japanese: 「ま、待て妹よ、泣くことはない。いや、話すと長くなるんだがこれには深いわけが……」
lines.english: “W-wait, my dear sister! There is no need to cry. The full explanation is rather lengthy, but there are profound reasons for this...”

lines.japanese: 小鳩を悲しませてはならない、という生まれながらの本能にしたがって、俺たちは狼狽する彼女に安堵をもたらそうと試みた。
lines.english: Following the instinct all of us had been born with—never make Kobato cry—we tried to reassure her.

lines.japanese: つまり、お兄ちゃんが決して妹だ～い好きな変態ではないのだと、理論立てて伝えたかったのだ。
lines.english: That is, I wanted to explain logically that her big brother was certainly not some pervert who just loooved his little sister.

lines.japanese: 「え、えーとだな、まずクオリアという言葉があるんだが、って説明そっからかよ！　おまえ、妹どんだけ半裸で待たせるつもりだよ！」
lines.english: “W-well, to begin with, there's this word *qualia*—wait, you're starting the explanation there!? How long are you planning to leave your half-dressed sister waiting!?”

lines.japanese: 理論立てるつもりが、なぜか俺たちはセルフ喧嘩を始めていた。
lines.english: Though I had intended to construct a logical argument, we had somehow begun fighting with ourselves.

lines.japanese: 「いいや、これは俺ひとりの責任だと言えるだろうか。じゃあ誰のせいなんだ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。なんだと、おまえだって俺なんだからそんなこと俺に言うなよ。まあまあみんな落ちついて。ていうかおまえ誰」
lines.english: “No, can this truly be called my responsibility alone? Then whose fault is it? I'll fucking kill you, asshole. What did you say? You're me too, so don't say that to me. Now, now, everyone calm down. Wait, who are you?”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ふえええええーん！」
lines.english: “Waaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「アレッ！？　小鳩さんどこ行くの！」
lines.english: “Huh!? Kobato, where are you going?”

lines.japanese: あまりに俺が出ていかないので、彼女は自分から出ていってしまった。
lines.english: When I still refused to leave, she finally fled the room herself.

lines.japanese: 「ははは、下着姿のまま家を走りまわるなんて、まだまだあいつも子供だな。言ってる場合か！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. Running through the house in her underwear—she's still such a child. This is no time to say that!”

lines.japanese: 一人ボケツッコミが染みついてしまいそうな俺たちだった。
lines.english: We seemed in danger of making a habit of playing both halves of a comedy routine by ourselves.

lines.japanese: 「でもそんなところも可愛いよなあ、うちの妹。だから言ってる場合か！」
lines.english: “But even that is adorable, isn't it? My little sister. Again, this is no time to say that!”

lines.japanese: しつこかった。
lines.english: It was getting tiresome.

lines.japanese: 「と、いうわけで」
lines.english: “And that is what happened.”

lines.japanese: ことのあらましを説明したあと、俺は小鳩の淹れてくれた玄米茶を一口すすって──
lines.english: After explaining the general course of events, I took a sip of the roasted-rice tea Kobato had made—

lines.japanese: 「朝といい今といい、重ね重ね失礼いたしましたっ」
lines.english: “For both this morning and just now, I most humbly apologize!”

lines.japanese: ──土下座した。
lines.english: —and prostrated myself.

lines.japanese: 「ええと？　とうごう……？」
lines.english: “Um... Integration?”

lines.japanese: 対して困惑中の小鳩。まあ無理もない。
lines.english: Kobato, for her part, remained bewildered. Understandably so.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そう。そんなわけでちょっと認識力が混乱……というか、安定してないようで、決して悪気はなかったんだ。決して見たかったわけじゃないんだ」
lines.english: “Y-yes. So my powers of recognition are a little confused—or perhaps unstable. I meant no harm at all. I certainly didn't *want* to see anything.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、それはいい」
lines.english: “Y-yeah. That's okay.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、待て、いいことはないぞ。おまえもそろそろ変な虫が寄りつくお年頃なんだから、きちんと恥じらいというものは持ってだな……」
lines.english: “No, wait. It is not okay. You're reaching the age when creeps will start sniffing around, so you must cultivate a proper sense of modesty—”

lines.japanese: 「そじゃなくて、あの、だから……」
lines.english: “That's not what I mean. I mean...”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、なの？」
lines.english: “Are you... my big brother?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「私のお兄ちゃん……で、いいの？」
lines.english: “It's okay for me to think of you... as my big brother?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: そうか。小鳩は今までずっと、俺が帰ってくるのを待っててくれたんだもんな。
lines.english: Of course. Kobato had been waiting all this time for me to come home.

lines.japanese: 俺は正座を崩してあぐらを組んだ。
lines.english: I relaxed from formal kneeling and sat cross-legged.

lines.japanese: 「そうだぞ、ポッポ。おれはおまえのお兄ちゃんだでー」
lines.english: “Yup, Poppo. I'm your big brother, y'know.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「さっき言ったでしょー。おれもう、みんないっしょなんだで。ホークもイーグルもファルコンもガルーダも──」
lines.english: “I told you, didn't I? 'Cause we're all together now. Hawk and Eagle and Falcon and Garuda—”

lines.japanese: 「伊丹さんも！？」
lines.english: “Mr. Itami too!?”

lines.japanese: 「あ……ご、ごめんなさい……」
lines.english: “Oh... S-sorry...”

lines.japanese: 「うぉんむ、うぉんむ、喜んでいただけて光栄至極ですぞ姫。これよりは永劫おそばにお仕えいたします」
lines.english: “Hrrm, hrrm. Your delight honors me beyond measure, Princess. Henceforth, I shall serve eternally at your side.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、三日見れば慣れるということばを信じます」
lines.english: “Y-yes. I'll put my faith in the saying that you can get used to anything after three days.”

lines.japanese: 「本来俺たちはみんな、それぞれの足りない部分を補うために生まれてきたんだ。だから伽楼羅も俺たちに欠かせないものを持ってる。全員が必要なんだ」
lines.english: “Every one of us was born to make up for something the others lacked. Karura has something essential to us, too. None of us can be left out.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は大きな息をつき、そしてにっこり笑った。
lines.english: Kobato released a long breath, then smiled brightly.

lines.japanese: 「うん、分かった。みんな、おかえりなさい」
lines.english: “Okay. I understand. Welcome home, everybody.”

lines.japanese: あたたかく迎えいれてくれた。
lines.english: She welcomed us warmly.
“Kobato...”

lines.japanese: ううっ。俺は形而上の目頭を押さえた。
lines.english: Ngh. I dabbed at the inner corners of my metaphysical eyes.

lines.japanese: なんていい子なんだろう。思わず抱きしめたくなった。
lines.english: What a wonderful girl she was. I wanted to sweep her into my arms.

lines.japanese: い、いや、そんなにヘンな意味じゃないよ。べつにそんな、妹にそんな、ありえないしそんな。こんなの普通の家族愛だし、だからヘンとか言うやつがヘンなんだよ。ヘンとか言うやつは頭いかれてるんだよ。
lines.english: N-no, not like that. She was my sister. I would never—nothing like that. This was perfectly normal family love, and anyone who called it weird was the weird one. Anyone who called it weird was out of their mind.

lines.japanese: 「えへっ、じゃあ今日はごちそうにするね。うーん、なんにしよっかなー。みんなが好きなの一品ずつ作ろっかなー」
lines.english: “Hee hee. Then I'll make us a feast tonight. Hmm, what should I cook? Maybe one favorite dish for each of you.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が夕食の支度のために立ちあがった。どうやら腕によりをかけてくれるらしい。
lines.english: Kobato rose to begin preparing dinner. It seemed she meant to spare no effort.

lines.japanese: たんすから新しいエプロンを引っぱりだし、鼻歌まじりに隣りのダイニングへ向かった。
lines.english: She pulled a fresh apron from the dresser and went humming into the adjoining dining room.

lines.japanese: 俺はちゃぶ台に頬杖をついて、食器だか調理具だかの触れ合う音を心地よく聞いていた。
lines.english: I rested my cheek on one hand at the low table, contentedly listening to the clink of dishes and cooking utensils.

lines.japanese: いいなあ。こういう時間。
lines.english: This was nice. Quiet moments like this.

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、おにーいちゃん♪」
lines.english: “Big brooo♪”

lines.japanese: 両手におたまと菜箸を持った小鳩が、戸口からひょっこり頭を出した。
lines.english: Kobato poked her head around the doorway, a ladle in one hand and cooking chopsticks in the other.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なに」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「呼んでみただけー」
lines.english: “Just felt like calling you.”

lines.japanese: ひゅっ、と姿を消す妹。ぱたぱたスリッパの足音を噛みしめながら、俺はしみじみつぶやいた。
lines.english: My sister ducked out of sight again. Savoring the patter of her slippers, I murmured with feeling.

lines.japanese: 「癒されるなあ」
lines.english: “This really does soothe the soul.”

lines.japanese: その日は夜遅くまで小鳩と話をした。
lines.english: That night, Kobato and I talked until late.

lines.japanese: 懐かしい話や最近の話、漫画の話や勉強の話、その他もろもろ。明日もまた学校だけど、まあ今日くらいは夜更かしさせてもいいだろう。
lines.english: Old stories and recent ones, comics and schoolwork, and all sorts of other things. There was school again tomorrow, but surely one late night would do no harm.

lines.japanese: コンドルさん、ごめん。おれ、やっぱりこっちの方が面白いや。
lines.english: Sorry, Condor. I think this world really is more fun.

lines.japanese: おやすみなさい、また明日。
lines.english: Good night. See you tomorrow.
